title: Modification
description: Modification object. Expected to use the currency of the parent object.

id.description: The modification identifier. Should be recognized by both the Platform and the Business.

price.description: Unit price in ISO 4217 minor units.

quantity.description: Quantity of the modification. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

media.description: Modification media assets (e.g., modification photos). First item is the featured media for presentation in food ordering surfaces.
